source_semantics.review: Do not impose this upstream zoneless lint/test-layout policy on the owned historical runner. Two scrolling callbacks, two viewport callbacks and the autofill root-suite rename are five exact callback relocations, with 64 cases retained and 57 equal complete callbacks. New zone files introduce distinct standalone fixture/provider/setup scopes; equal callbacks do not prove equal teardown or viewport DOM preparation. The experimental popover fixture adds notification/render steps, and the lint walker examines local named-import identifiers while its allowlist narrows spec exemptions. Dev-app lint annotations and experimental controls are outside the legacy product. Retain owned MockNgZone/zoneful preparation, strict errors/public stability and historical layout; real resize/scroll/keyboard/observer execution, SSR, artifacts and floors stay open.
